key_insight: CIDERS frames cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a personalized bilevel optimization problem, using consensus-variate correction to jointly preserve global knowledge transfer and local edge personalization.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical solver for deploying LLMs on cloud-edge systems where shared backbone knowledge must be adapted efficiently to edge-specific tasks.
method: Split the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger.
Use a bilevel objective: edge-side personalization at the upper level, cloud-side knowledge transfer at the lower level.
Inject global trajectory information into each local update via consensus-variate correction.
evidence_signal: Experiments show CIDERS outperforms baselines on compressed edge benchmarks, with 3.1x gains in mathematical reasoning, 1.7x in code generation, and a 10% relative improvement on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach relies on coordinated cloud-edge optimization, so communication overhead and stability under heterogeneous edge workloads may be important implementation concerns.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
